fields.statement: QA with test binaries built by go test -trimpath -c (and -race -c) to $TMPDIR, run from internal/api under the machine lock: ^TestSnapshotFixture passed with -test.count=2 -test.cpu=1,4 shuffled and with -race -test.count=3 -test.cpu=1,4; a mix of serial XDG_CACHE_HOME/run-tmp tests (TestAbandonRemovesRunGoTmp, TestDaemonSweepLeftovers*) with initSnapshot/linkEndpoints users (TestChange*, TestLink*) passed with -test.count=2 -test.cpu=1,4, -test.parallel=1 and -test.parallel=16 shuffled. A -test.timeout=5s kill leaves rhiza-api-cache-*/rhiza-api-snapshots-* behind, and the next run's TestMain sweeps them once over tmpsweep.MaxAge (checked by back-dating them); a normal run leaves none.

QA with test binaries built by go test -trimpath -c (and -race -c) to $TMPDIR, run from internal/api under the machine lock: The 214 newSessionFixture-file tests passed shuffled twice (seeds 7741, 90210; ~10 s each) and once under -race shuffled with no data race; ~/.cache/rhiza/run-tmp was unchanged across every run, and no new rhiza-api-* temp folder stayed after a normal run.

QA with test binaries built by go test -trimpath -c (and -race -c) to $TMPDIR, run from internal/api under the machine lock: The 208 runtime-file tests passed shuffled twice (seeds 31337, 424242; ~65 s each); under -race the whole group overran a 250 s timeout as one command, so it ran in three parts (daemon_ 46, run_ 79, ship_/watchdog_/health_/usage_/feed_ 83 tests; 53 s, 28 s, 210 s), each passing with no data race. The slow part is the serial usage_ tests at 23-28 s each under -race, not a hang.

QA with test binaries built by go test -trimpath -c (and -race -c) to $TMPDIR, run from internal/api under the machine lock: The 139 rest-group tests passed shuffled twice (seeds 31337, 424242) and under -race shuffled (106 s) with no data race.

QA with test binaries built by go test -trimpath -c (and -race -c) to $TMPDIR, run from internal/api under the machine lock: The 201 model-group tests passed shuffled twice (seeds 31337, 424242; ~70 s each); under -race in two halves of 100/101 tests there was no data race; the only failure was TestRootIdlePollBudget's CPU budget under -race, which failed before this change set too.

QA with test binaries built by go test -trimpath -c (and -race -c) to $TMPDIR, run from internal/api under the machine lock: The whole package, skipping the three budget tests, passed with -test.shuffle=8086 in 157 s wall on the busy shared VM and left no new temp folder; go vet ./internal/api is clean; the top-level Test funcs differ from the merge-base only by the five added TestSnapshotFixture* tests and TestMain (none removed); non-test .go files are unchanged from the merge-base.
